_note: DRAFT. Original characters, all adults. No real people. Names are placeholders the team can change here in one place.

crew.name: Ana Reyes
crew.line: Every plant here has a name. Yes, even the radishes.
crew.bio: Ana grew up on a farm and spent ten years learning how to grow food where nothing should grow. The greenhouse is her life's work.
crew.arc: Her dwarf tomato plant, Little Sol, is the first tomato ever grown from seed on Mars. If the lights stay on, it ripens on the last sol.

crew.name: Kenji Mori
crew.line: If it hums, I can fix it. If it stops humming, I can fix it faster.
crew.bio: Kenji keeps the air, water and power running. He jokes when he is worried, so listen for the jokes.
crew.arc: He built the storm shelter's air system himself and has never had to trust it with his friends inside.

crew.name: Zara Okafor
crew.line: This delta was a lake once. Lakes keep secrets.
crew.bio: Zara reads rocks the way other people read books. She came to Jezero for one rock in particular.
crew.arc: She will take almost any risk for the sample. Whether she listens to you depends on how much she trusts you.

earth.name: Mission Control
earth.line: Shoreline, this is Earth. By the time you hear this, it is already old news.

tasks.label: Tend the greenhouse
tasks.gives: Plants grow faster and stay healthy.
tasks.costs: Nobody is digging, fixing or exploring.

tasks.label: Fix and maintain
tasks.gives: Broken systems get fixed. Machines waste less.
tasks.costs: The plants and the science wait.

tasks.label: Pile soil on the shelter
tasks.gives: A thicker shield for the next storm.
tasks.costs: Hard work in a suit. Very tiring.

tasks.label: Go to the delta
tasks.gives: One step closer to the sample.
tasks.costs: Needs the rover charged. Far from the shelter.

tasks.label: Rest
tasks.gives: Tired people make mistakes. Rest fixes that.
